Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "we finished the screen reader audit of the harbor permit portal on tuesday no wednesday morning after the latest patch and i listened with mina in the small test room uh the first issue was on the application status page the screen reader said pending twice before it announced the date and the second issue was that the back to results link sounded like plain text instead of a link mina asked if the alert tone should play before the heading and i said right it should play once before the heading not after every field we also checked the phone layout with the display set to two hundred percent and the focus stayed on the save button when the confirmation banner appeared that part worked as expected i started to say the label on the upload control was missing but i mean the label was present it was the allowed file types note that was not read aloud we wrote down chrome version one hundred twenty four and voiceover version fourteen point four for the test record and i have not sent the findings to the web team yet because they asked us to wait until the second reviewer checks the keyboard flow", "output": "We finished the screen reader audit of the Harbor Permit Portal on Tuesday—no, Wednesday morning—after the latest patch, and I listened with Mina in the small test room. The first issue was on the application status page: the screen reader said “pending” twice before it announced the date. The second issue was that the “Back to results” link sounded like plain text instead of a link. Mina asked if the alert tone should play before the heading, and I said, “Right, it should play once before the heading, not after every field.” We also checked the phone layout with the display set to 200 percent, and the focus stayed on the Save button when the confirmation banner appeared. That part worked as expected. I started to say the label on the upload control was missing, but I mean the label was present; it was the allowed file types note that was not read aloud. We wrote down Chrome version 124 and VoiceOver version 14.4 for the test record, and I have not sent the findings to the web team yet because they asked us to wait until the second reviewer checks the keyboard flow."}]
